judged_text: The BOOKING_REJECTED webhook payload's destinationCalendar field changes shape from DestinationCalendar|null to DestinationCalendar[] (null becomes []) — an unversioned breaking change to the public webhook contract, evidenced by the updated assertion `destinationCalendar: []`. Existing webhook consumers (Zapier/Make/custom endpoints) reading payload.destinationCalendar.externalId silently get undefined on every booking payload, breaking downstream calendar syncs with no error signal and no payload version bump.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes `destinationCalendar` from a single `DestinationCalendar | null` to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` in shared types (`packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`, `packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`) and updates the webhook E2E assertion for `BOOKING_REJECTED` from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`). That is a backward-incompatible shape change for any webhook consumers expecting `payload.destinationCalendar.externalId`. The diff does not show any webhook versioning/migration shim, so the compatibility concern is grounded, but it’s more of an API-contract/breaking-change issue than an internal correctness bug within this diff alone.
